items.title: Does Medtronic (MDT) Still Trade At A Discount After Its CE Mark Win?
items.summary: Medtronic stock has delivered a 20.8% gain over the past three years, yet current checks suggest it now sits close to its estimated intrinsic value rather than at a clear discount. At the same time, earnings-based multiples still screen the shares as undervalued, which sets up a debate over how much upside is left from here.
